Reminders about carrier checks for everyone using the desk
What you should know comes first
Carrier checks at the Companion Animal Travel Desk

This note helps keep carrier checks smooth and calm for travelers and animals alike. The desk team reviews each carrier with steady attention, and the aim is to make the process predictable from the start.

Please bring the carrier in its usual travel condition, with doors, latches, and seams in place. The carrier should be clean, secure, and sized to support the animal without crowding. A handler may ask to see how the carrier closes, how air can move through it, and whether the base stays stable when lifted.

The passenger coordinator explains the travel steps and records any needed details before boarding. If a carrier needs a small adjustment, the desk team will point out the issue in plain language and let you correct it when possible. The focus is always on humane handling, calm movement, and clear records.

During the visit, travelers should keep the animal settled and avoid opening the carrier unless asked. Soft voice, slow motion, and a calm stance often help the check go more easily. The welcome team then prepares passengers for boarding once the paperwork and carrier review are complete.

If a pet seems anxious, the cabin team is ready to monitor the animal during flight and maintain careful oversight. You do not need to manage every detail alone, since the desk works with you through each step and keeps the record in order.

For extra help, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways and a team member will guide you with care.
